freeze_stage: Before any regional experiment spending error calculation; source discovery only
cohort: Same 2075 IDs with all 12 observed 2023 months; no 2024 completeness filter
availability: Publication plus one calendar day; date of composition is not publication. Current snapshots are not independently archived historical vintages.
claim_selection: Existing whole named region seasonal claims, separated by variable and climate reference; new sources require explicit publication, event period and whole named region. Exclude prior-year comparisons, partial regions, district expansion, map or city extrapolation, retrospective observations from forecast features.
source_sampling: Existing dated forecast/warning title census plus bounded primary official source searches for 2023/2024 monthly forecasts, dated regional events, and same municipal spending beyond2024. No spending-error-directed article selection. Do not retry known inaccessible fire36703.
gate_rationale: Minimum diversity safeguard, not a power calculation. Municipalities do not substitute for independent releases; failure rejects confirmatory fit.
features: Temperature and precipitation directions by distinct source climate baseline, known indicators and explicit negative indicators; unknown encoded direction=NaN with known=0, never normal direction0. Hazard presence only when stated interval overlaps target month and available before origin month end.
model: Same HGB fixed config as news_corpus_audit with five base features and clipped log changes; no tuning or arm selection; if gate fails no spending-error fit
evaluation: Same observed history/target pairs in both arms. Report overall and news-covered MAE, monthly differences and coverage separately. 2024 is reused exploratory evaluation, not independent holdout.
event_registry: Official dated real events remain contextual records, not labels of spending structural shifts. Incomplete registry cannot establish false positives.
review: Single assistant extraction; not independently reviewed
